name: fill-down
description:
The table where, in each named column, an empty cell takes the value of the nearest filled cell above it.

A cell that holds only spaces is empty too. Empty cells before the first filled cell stay as they are. The other columns do not change. A column that is not in the table is refused, naming the columns there are.

column: the column to fill; repeat it for each next column.

Example: semkit read rows/groups.csv fill-down --column group write -
-> , 0; A, 1; A, 2; A, 3; B, 4; B, 5

The step changes the cells of the named columns only. Without --column it fills the working column, which stays the same.

options.name: --column
options.description: the column to fill; repeat it for each next column.
